author: Yffe
content: Doc §4(ii): 'STALENESS is defined as the obligation hash CHANGING (the ast_slice + env hash, the same content the cache keys)'. Code: cache::cache_key hashes FIVE inputs — lowered source, seed, verus_version, thermite_version, CHECK_SCHEMA_VERSION (cache.rs REQ-1/REQ-5, blocker #49) — not ast_slice+env, so the parenthetical is a misquote. Substantively: the shipped key's version-keyed invalidation (verus_version; CHECK_SCHEMA_VERSION for gate changes) has NO Lean analog anywhere in the doc — §2(d) adds only 'an engine discriminator'. An obligation-hash-only key lets a cached Proven evidence be re-served after (1) a Lean toolchain/mathlib/Lean-SMT bump or (2) a change to the lean/Thermite/ spine definitions the exported theorem instantiates — a stale proof silently revalidated, violating the hit==fresh-verify invariant (cache.rs REQ-2) the design claims to generalize. CI replay does not save the cacheable-EVIDENCE path (a cache hit skips replay). Correction: evidence_key = obligation hash + engine + engine toolchain version(s) + the targeted spine content hash; REQ-7 staleness likewise.
